name: Hopeless Romantic
source:
You wake up to find an overeager suitor pawing through your laundry bin. Your reactions to this strange young man may just save you... or doom you to a worse fate than death.

[From [url=https://bonecandy.itch.io/hopeless-romantic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来发现一个过于热心的追求者正在翻你的洗衣箱。你对这个奇怪的年轻人的反应可能只会拯救你……或者注定你会面临比死亡更糟糕的命运。

[来自[url=https://bonecandy.itch.io/hopeless-romantic]Itch.io[/url]]
